permission_scope: Issue #557 target-independent coverage/redundancy precheck only; not yet approved for use in an Experiment feature
analysis_scope: target-independent Pfam domain coverage and residue-position semantic redundancy precheck (Issue #557)

source.protein_id_selection: representative isoform per trusted (gene, token) pair in train+test, mirroring IsoformRelativePositionTransformer's MANE>canonical>other selection -- not every isoform listed in competition_gene_isoform_index.json

license.data_terms: Ensembl data generated by project members are available without restriction; third-party constraints may still apply.

interpretation_limits: Pfam domain calls describe the representative Ensembl protein sequence only; they are not patient-specific and do not encode SUBCLASS or any clinical label.
Domain boundaries are static per protein_id and were not chosen or filtered by SUBCLASS, test distribution, or Public LB.
